figurative_meaning_en: to bully, show off authority, boast arrogantly, or act superior
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাস্তায় ছড়ি ঘোরানো শুরু করেছে, সবাইকে ভয় দেখাচ্ছে।
এখানে ছড়ি ঘোরানোর দরকার নেই, শান্ত থাকো।
example_sentences_in_english: He's started twirling his stick on the street, intimidating everyone.
There's no need to throw your weight around here; stay calm.
note: Refers to the act of goons or local toughs twirling sticks to assert dominance in urban or semi-urban Bengali settings.
